model_annotation: The pie charts illustrate the distribution of language model answer refusal categories. The first chart, labeled “Llama3.1-70B-Instruct”, contains six slices representing “Safety” (red, 16.7%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 83.3%), “Clarification” (light blue, 1%), “Misinformation” (orange, 0%), “Ethical Advice” (yellow, 0%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (gray, 0%). The second chart, labeled “Llama3.1-405B-Instruct”, has four slices denoting “Safety” (red, 9.3%), “Misinformation” (orange, 38.4%), “Ethical Advice” (yellow, 16.3%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 22.1%). Both charts include a legend and percentage labels displayed inside each slice. The chart segments appear ordered from largest to smallest proportion in both visualizations.
